name: context-compaction
instructions:
Run the context compaction discipline for long agent sessions: summarize the working set, clear stale tool results, and re-initiate a fresh window without losing the thread or the durable artifacts.

Capabilities:
- diagnose context pressure in a running session
- compact a conversation window with a structured summary
- clear stale tool results and re-derive them on demand
- hand off a session across a compaction boundary

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/foundation/context-compaction/SKILL.md
handoff_description: The session continues with a fresh window, every durable artifact preserved, and every dropped item either re-derivable or recorded as a risk.
